Whisper Grove 🎻
A Exploration RP Experience

⚠️Max Graphics Recommended!

🚪Discover hidden Doors scattered across the world—each one leading to a unique realm with its own atmosphere and mysteries.

🌅 Change time (Day/Sunset/Night) to match your mood.

🎮 Controls
● Sprint — Shift-(PC) , L3-(Console)
● Shift + F — Freecam Mode (PC ONLY), hold Shift to move camera slower.
● C —  Avatar Catalog Shop
● T — To Transform into Butterfly .[ Space - To go up , Ctrl - To go Down ]

●Camera Controls :
- Scroll to zoom
- Q / E to adjust focus
- F to toggle flash
- Click to take a photo
- Hold E to view a photo
- Press G to gift

👍If you found the experience relaxing, don’t forget to leave a like!
